# Pax26

> AI-powered WhatsApp Commerce platform. Build your online store, automate customer conversations, and convert WhatsApp chats into sales — 24/7.

Pax26 is a SaaS platform for African and global businesses that want to sell products and services through WhatsApp using AI automation, an online storefront, and an intelligent chatbot — all managed from one dashboard.

## Docs

- [Homepage](https://www.pax26.com/): Main landing page with product overview, features, and pricing
- [Pricing](https://www.pax26.com/#pricing): Subscription plans — Starter (free), Pro, and Business tiers
- [Blog](https://www.pax26.com/blog): Articles about WhatsApp commerce, AI automation, and small business growth
- [About](https://www.pax26.com/about): Company background and mission
- [Contact](https://www.pax26.com/contact): Support and contact information
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.pax26.com/privacy): Data privacy and usage policy
- [Terms of Service](https://www.pax26.com/terms): Platform terms and conditions

## Platform

- [Sign Up](https://www.pax26.com/?auth=signup): Create a free Pax26 account to start building your WhatsApp store
- [Login](https://www.pax26.com/?auth=login): Access the Pax26 dashboard
- [Dashboard](https://www.pax26.com/dashboard): Manage your WhatsApp store, automations, and orders
- [My Store](https://www.pax26.com/dashboard/my-store): Configure your online storefront and product catalogue
- [AI Automations](https://www.pax26.com/dashboard/automations/market-place): Browse and activate WhatsApp automation flows and AI chatbots
- [Tutorial](https://www.pax26.com/tutorial): 2-part video masterclass on using Pax26

## Optional

- [AI Agent Manifest](https://www.pax26.com/.well-known/agent.json): Structured agent capabilities manifest for AI agents
- [Sitemap](https://www.pax26.com/sitemap.xml): Full site XML sitemap
